summary: Complete testing of User Access Management features (iteration 14). All backend tests passed (16/16). Frontend UI verified working: Admin Users tab shows Pause Access/Restore/Remove buttons, status badges (Active/Paused/Removed), and pausing user works via UI. Backend correctly blocks suspended/removed user login with warren@firegold.ca contact message.

issues: Minor React hydration warning about <tr> inside <span> - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality
